could_do_better: A better seat looks overdue for {names}.
The car is the limiting factor for {names}, not the driving.

A quick car is doing the talking for {names}.
quote_could_do_better: Give me a car that can fight and I will show you what I can actually do.
I am tired of driving around in the midfield when I know I belong at the front.
The results hide how much I am having to drag this car to where it finishes.
I need machinery that matches my ambition, and right now it does not.
People judge you by the car, and mine is not doing me any favours right now.
I have never worked harder for fewer points and I think I deserve better than this.
One season in a proper car and the conversations about my talent would change completely.
quote_right_place: I am settled here, the car suits me, and we are only getting started.
This team understands how I drive, and that chemistry is not easy to find.
Everything fits right now, the car, the people, the direction, and I am not in a hurry to change any of it.
We have built something real here and walking away from that would be a mistake.
The car does what I ask of it and that trust takes time to build at any team.
I feel at home in this car and that is rarer than people realise.
The fit between me and this team is the best I have had in my career.
quote_lucky: People underrate how hard I work for these results, and I have earned every point.
The car is quick, yes, but you still have to put it in the right place every single lap.
Nobody drives a fast car slowly and expects these results, the work goes in every weekend.
I would rather be in a good car than a bad one, and I make no apology for that.
A fast car helps, but it does not steer itself, and the details still fall to me.
Strong machinery gives you the opportunity, it does not convert the opportunity, I do that.
The car is competitive and so am I, and I do not think one cancels the other out.

renewed: Staying put for the season ahead, {names}.
expiring: Heading to the open market without a deal, {names}.
quote_renewed: Staying was the easy call, this is exactly where I want to be.
We have unfinished business here and I could not imagine pursuing it anywhere else.
This team gave me everything I needed to grow and I am not done repaying that.
I signed before we even really started talking to anyone else, it was that straightforward.
There is a real project being built here and I want to be part of where it ends up.
The people, the direction, the car, everything told me to stay and so I stayed.
Re-signing was not a difficult conversation, we both wanted the same thing.
quote_expiring: I know my worth, and I am going to find the right seat for the next chapter.
My future is open and honestly that is an exciting position to be in right now.
There are options and I am taking the time to evaluate them properly, not rushing anything.
Going on the market means people have to come to me and I welcome that conversation.
I have delivered in this sport and the right team will know what they are getting.
Free agency is not a threat, it is an opportunity, and I intend to use it well.
The market opens up things that a contract renewal never could, and I am genuinely interested.

quote_signed: This is the move I have wanted for a long time, and I cannot wait to get going.
Everything I have worked toward points to this moment, and the timing feels right.
New team, new chapter, and I am walking in with nothing to prove and everything to give.
The people I spoke to made it clear they believe in me and that belief is mutual.
I have been watching this team from the outside and now I get to help build it from the inside.
Landing this seat took a lot of work and I intend to make every lap count from day one.
This is where I wanted to be and I am not going to waste a single test session getting comfortable.
quote_dropped: I gave everything I had, and I am not finished with this sport, not by a long way.
Losing a seat hurts, but it does not define what I am capable of and I know that.
The door has closed here and that is sport, but I will find the right door and walk through it.
I am proud of what I delivered in that car and the results speak for anyone willing to look honestly.
This is a setback, not an ending, and I will be back on a grid because I belong here.
Plenty of drivers have come back stronger after a year like this and I intend to be one of them.
The sport owes me nothing and I owe it everything, so I will keep showing up until I get my chance.
